server_name.description: MCP server name expected by the workflow. Use logic-apps-standard-mcp.

tool_name.description: Approved MCP tool name. Must be createServiceNowTicket for this workflow.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID used for audit, tracing, troubleshooting, and response correlation.

shortDescription.description: Short description for the ServiceNow ticket. If omitted, a default integration support description is used.

assignmentGroup.description: ServiceNow assignment group that should own the ticket. If omitted, Integration Support is used.

payload.description: Tool-specific payload for ServiceNow ticket creation. Use after governance approval for high-risk operational actions.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional requested timeout in seconds for the MCP tool execution.

schema.description: MCP request envelope for the createServiceNowTicket tool.

When_an_HTTP_request_is_received.description: Use this high-risk tool to create a ServiceNow incident or support ticket for an integration issue after approval. Optional payload fields can describe the issue and assignment group.

inputs.shortDescription: @coalesce(triggerBody()?['payload']?['shortDescription'], 'Integration support ticket created by governed MCP workflow')

body.message: Remote MCP execution completed by local Logic Apps workflow.

definition.description: Use this high-risk tool to create a ServiceNow incident or support ticket for an integration issue after approval. Optional payload fields can describe the issue and assignment group.
